confirmed.verdict: Reproduced twice on pinchofyum. Sift's 'Jump to Recipe' link (href ...#tasty-recipes-39213-jump-target) is at y=282 before and after the click. Focus stays on the link, the host's scrollTop stays 0, location.hash stays empty, and the original's scrollY goes to 15635. The recipe card is in Sift: h2 'The Best Soft Chocolate Chip Cookies' at y=14116 and Ingredients at 14485, so there is a place to go. Other in-page links do work: clicking the 'Chocolate Chip Cookies: Frequently Asked Questions' link focuses that h2 at y=72. The target is <span class=tasty-recipes-jump-target style=display:block> with no content, a direct child of div.entry-content. In Sift's main only headings and one details element carry data-key. Inference: in showPlace(), the loose pick takes found.around (the article block that holds the span) before found.after. That block has no data-key element in the shadow DOM, so showPlace returns without scrolling or focusing. Also, found.after is the first match in Sift's order, not DOM order: 'Featured comment' sits early in Sift but late in the DOM.
confirmed.fix: src/content/index.ts showPlace(): when found.inside is empty and the target has no rendered text (an empty jump-target span), use the nearest block after the target in document order (here the recipe h2 'h:r2l') before found.around. Pick found.after by DOM position, not by Sift's walk order. If the chosen block has no [data-key] element, fall back to the next block that has one instead of returning silently.

confirmed.title: 'Copy link' / 'Copy' buttons that copy with document.execCommand (clipboard.js, copy-to-clipboard) copy nothing in Sift, while the page says 'Link copied'
confirmed.where: src/content/shield.ts:48 (no portals: the whole <body> is made inert) with src/content/index.ts:3319 (H.act replays the click with the page still inert)
confirmed.evidence: New fixture http://127.0.0.1:8799/fx/r10int-copylink.html. Its Copy link button copies the way clipboard.js does: a read-only textarea appended to <body>, select(), execCommand('copy'), then removed. ?lib=c2c copies the way the copy-to-clipboard package does (a span in <body>, a range, execCommand). Clipboard seeded with 'BEFORE', read back through CDP permissions. Original: clipboard = the event URL, copy-event selection = the URL, the fake textarea is focused. Sift: execCommand returns true, the copy event fires with selection "", the textarea is not focused, and the clipboard stays 'BEFORE'. The page still shows 'Link copied', and ?lib=c2c behaves the same. Control 1: ?api=1 (navigator.clipboard.writeText) copies correctly in Sift. Control 2: ?portal=1 adds a shown iframe, so body is not inert as a whole (document.body.inert false). Both execCommand patterns then copy correctly in Sift, which isolates the cause: an element the page appends to an inert <body> cannot take focus or a selection during the click. Before round 9 these buttons were dropped (F904), so the button is new, but it fails silently with a false 'copied' message. GitHub's Copy path and Docusaurus' code Copy use navigator.clipboard and work.
confirmed.repro: No test Chrome running needed beyond: SIFT_PORT=9467 ./scripts/chrome.sh start; cd /tmp/claude-1001/-home-nico/aac11194-acaf-4dad-a334-0620115b1898/scratchpad/r10int; SIFT_PORT=9467 SIFT_TAB=R2-interaction bun copy.ts prints SIFT {..."execCommand true, fake focused=false"..., msg 'Link copied', clipboard 'BEFORE'}. Then: 'bun copy.ts orig' (clipboard = URL), 'bun copy.ts sift "?lib=c2c"' (BEFORE), 'bun copy.ts sift "?portal=1"' (URL).
confirmed.suspectedCause: With no exceptions, shield.ts desired() adds document.body itself to the inert set, so anything the page appends to body during Sift's replayed click is inert. When portals exist, only body's children are inert, and a new child stays usable until the next refreshShield. Lead: make body's children inert instead of body, as the exceptions path already does, or replay H.act clicks inside withoutShield(…, el).
confirmed.verdict: Confirmed, high severity: execCommand-based Copy buttons copy nothing in Sift but still say 'Link copied'. I ran the reporter's fixture /fx/r10int-copylink.html. In Sift, the copy event fired with selection "", the active element was sift-root, the fake textarea was not focused, and the clipboard stayed 'BEFORE'. On the original, the clipboard got the URL. '?lib=c2c' behaved the same in Sift (still BEFORE). The controls held: '?portal=1' copied the URL in Sift, and '?api=1' (navigator.clipboard) copied it too.
